newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka set to launch new growth fund.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka set to launch new growth fund.

text.p: Sri Lanka's National Asset Management Ltd (NAMAL), which manages an income and growth fund, said it will launch a growth fund on June 30.

"We will launch the new unit trust called Namal Growth Fund, which will invest up to 90 percent of its value in the stock market," Nihal Dissanayake, general manager of NAMAL, told Reuters on Wednesday.

The Namal Growth Fund will be the second such fund to be launched in Sri Lanka. The Unit Trust Management Company, which manages the Ceybank Unit trust, launched Century Growth Fund earlier this year.

"We believe the launch is timely as the share market has picked up, interest rates are down, commodity prices are stable and more foreign direct investment is expected into the country," Dissanayake said.
Colombo stocks, which have risen over 30 percent this year due to improved sentiment, closed at a 26-month high of 804.2 points on Tuesday.
NAMAL is an associate of blue chip development finance institution Development Finance Corporation of Ceylon Ltd .
